events.verdict: Daniels (ATL) reaches for the ball and the contact with Lillard's (MIL) side is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) deflects the ball into the backcourt prior to Lopez (MIL) legally retrieving it.
Lopez (MIL) legally contests Gueye's (ATL) layup attempt and avoids making any illegal contact.
Replay review of the out of bounds called on Lopez (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Lopez is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Kuzma (MIL) legally contests Daniels' (ATL) driving shot attempt and any contact with his arm/hand after the release is incidental.
Okongwu (ATL) moves alongside of Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path before his shot is cleanly blocked by Gueye (ATL).
Okongwu (ATL) firms up in a screening position and any contact that occurs is marginal as Prince (MIL) moves around him.
Lopez (MIL) legally contests Young's (ATL) driving shot attempt.

Young (ATL) brushes Lillard's (MIL) arm during his drive to the basket and the contact does not affect his SQBR. Okongwu (ATL) then makes clean contact with the ball contesting Lillard's driving shot attempt.
Young (ATL) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Daniels (ATL) requests a timeout when the Hawks do not have any remaining and they are charged with an excessive timeout.
